customManagers.description: The Renovate image the validator runs, written as a docker run argument in ci.yml and the justfile, where no default manager reads it. Both copies move in one PR.

packageRules.description: The validator image is read only by the regex manager above, so the github-actions rule in the preset does not reach it. Without this its commits lose the ci: prefix, since the prefix otherwise comes from whichever manager's upgrade sorts first in the branch.
